The '''uprising''' of the [[Cult of Gethul]] occurred in [[3629 BBY]]<ref name="Year" /> when [[Gethul]] emerged from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]'s deeps and took over the minds of several minions, seeking to destroy the world. [[Alliance Commander|The Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] and his [[Eternal Alliance Recon Unit|recon unit]] travelled to Makeb and stopped Gethul and his followers.<ref name="DOW" />
